name: robots/abizovnuralem__go2_omniverse
title: Unitree Go2 velocity task in Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab (go2_omniverse)
intro: Unitree Go2 velocity task in Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab (go2_omniverse), adapted from abizovnuralem/go2_omniverse. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
